name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan, UT) "The Sampler" All-Day Country Breakfast
whyItWorks: Angie's legendary comfort breakfast! Lean ham steak and soft eggs are pure protein. Hash browns provide soft peeled potato starch with virtually zero roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order The Sampler with scrambled eggs, lean ham steak, well-done hash browns, and white toast with butter.
watchOuts: Skip spicy sausage links if feeling sensitive to greasier breakfast meats
